jobs.title: Marketing Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
With 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, Recorded Future is the world’s most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

Recorded Future is seeking a Marketing Analytics Manager. As a Marketing Analytics Manager, you will be a strategic partner across marketing decision-making, reporting to the Senior Manager of Marketing Analytics to execute on the reporting, measurement, and data foundation that helps the business make faster, smarter, outcome-driven decisions. You will articulate compelling buyer journey stories through data for  demand generation, field marketing, marketing operations, and the broader go-to-market organization. Beyond day-to-day analytics and ad hoc analysis, you'll help drive our growing investment in AI, automation, and modern data tooling, bringing curiosity and a builder's mindset to how we scale the analytics function. This role is ideal for a data-driven, business-minded analyst who wants to sit at the intersection of marketing strategy, measurement, and emerging data and AI capability in a B2B SaaS environment.

Note: This role is required to work from the Recorded Future office in Boston, MA at least 3 days per week.

What You'll Do:

Marketing Analytics & Strategic Insights:

- Serve as a strategic analytics partner across the marketing organization, translating data into insights that shape planning, investment, and campaign decisions and drive measurable business outcomes.

- Develop, maintain, and refresh marketing dashboards and reports across HockeyStack, Salesforce, Domo, and Adobe CJA to track KPIs, campaign effectiveness, and ROI.

- Report on top of funnel marketing performance, lead acquisition, conversion rates and velocity, and opportunity progression, to give a clear view of marketing's impact.

- Support reporting needs across all levels of the business, from executive leadership to individual executors, tailoring insight to each audience.

- Deliver ad hoc analysis, segment breakdowns, and channel/campaign deep dives that answer strategic questions on short turnaround.

Marketing Data Quality & Governance:

- Validate reporting and ensure the numbers reconcile across systems, so stakeholders can trust the metrics they act on.

- Troubleshoot and resolve integration and data discrepancies.

- Help build out the marketing data warehouse, partnering with the centralized data infrastructure team to establish a scalable, reliable data foundation.

- Help maintain the clean, consistent, well-governed data foundation that enables faster reporting, trusted metrics, and confident decision-making across marketing.

Attribution & Pipeline Measurement:

- Support the maintenance and evolution of multi-touch attribution models, keeping reporting objects current as campaigns and channels change.

- Partner with field marketing, revenue operations, and the Sales/BDR organizations on lead-to-opportunity reporting and analysis, ensuring accurate tracking of marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline.

- Translate attribution and pipeline data into actionable insights that help stakeholders make informed ROI decisions when planning activities.

Automation, Tooling & AI Innovation:

- Help drive our growing investment in AI and automation for marketing analytics, we're actively expanding into this space and want someone with the curiosity and passion to help shape it.

- Build and extend automation and data-access workflows, including API and MCP connections, that broaden analytics and AI tooling access for the Marketing Analytics & Operations team.

- Explore and apply emerging AI and data capabilities to increase analytics throughput, reduce manual work, and unlock new kinds of insight.

- Develop reusable reporting templates, lightweight data products, and cross-system data workflows that scale the team's impact.

What You'll Bring:

- 3+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing/revenue operations, or a related analytical field, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.

- Strong proficiency building dashboards and reports in tools such as HockeyStack, Domo, Tableau, or Sigma, or similar BI/visualization platforms.

- Hands-on experience with CRM data (particularly Salesforce) and marketing automation platforms (Marketo or HubSpot).

- Hands-on experience applying AI/LLM tooling to analytics or operations workflows.

- Experience building automations or integrations via APIs, with familiarity with emerging standards like MCP a plus.

- Working knowledge of SQL and/or Python for data analysis and cross-system data work.

- Self-driven and intellectually curious, with the initiative to dig into problems without waiting to be told how, you can pick up the business and domain along the way.

- Solid understanding of the marketing funnel, lead lifecycle, and attribution concepts (multi-touch, first-touch, last-touch).

- Curiosity and passion for AI, automation, and modern data tooling, with eagerness to help build in an emerging space.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights and business recommendations.

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey findings to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience with data warehousing (e.g., Snowflake) and data-quality, ETL, or data-pipeline processes.

- Exposure to customer journey analytics (e.g., Adobe CJA).

- Certification in Marketo or Salesforce.

- Previous experience in a high-growth, enterprise SaaS company.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $92,000-$137,500. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The salary displayed reflects the range for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by state, work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. This position may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and medical, dental, vision, life insurance and 401K. Your recruiter can share more about the specific details of the compensation and benefit package during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Senior Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
With 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, Recorded Future is the world’s most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

Recorded Future is seeking a Field Marketing Manager to help Recorded Future extend its leadership position in the Threat Intelligence industry by shaping and leading regional field marketing strategy across key growth markets. The role will focus on driving qualified opportunities, strengthening customer engagement, and supporting sales priorities through impactful, measurable marketing programs for the UKI, Nordics and Benelux regions.

The position will develop and oversee integrated regional marketing programs across industry events, user conferences, campaigns, account-based initiatives, and partner-led activities. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, and strategic partners across the region, the Field Marketing Manager will build joint plans, identify opportunities for collaboration, and execute activities together to maximise reach, engagement, and pipeline impact.

What You'll Do:

- Partner closely with EMEA Sales, Corporate Marketing, Digital Marketing, and Channel teams to develop and drive regional field marketing strategy aligned to business and pipeline priorities.

- Act as a strategic marketing partner to regional sales leadership, identifying opportunities and translating business priorities into impactful marketing programs.

- Build strong relationships with key partners across the region to develop joint marketing plans and execute co-marketing activities, including events, campaigns, webinars, and customer engagements, aligned to regional business and pipeline goals.

- Lead the planning and execution of field and partner-supported events, ensuring a cohesive pre-event, at-event, and post-event strategy and delivering a consistent customer experience.

- Own the regional strategy for key conferences and summits, including large-scale events, identifying opportunities to maximise participation and engagement with customers, prospects, sales teams, and partners.

- Develop and implement targeted account strategies to support account-based selling and accelerate engagement within priority accounts, including coordinating relevant partner engagement where appropriate.

- Collaborate with the broader marketing organisation and regional partners to develop relevant content and assets that support regional priorities.

- Establish clear program goals and forecasts; measure, analyse, and report on business impact, engagement, and pipeline contribution across field and joint partner activities.

- Maintain strong alignment with the EMEA BDR team to drive qualified leads through the funnel.

- Build strong cross-functional relationships and influence stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Channel, ensuring regional priorities are effectively represented and partner opportunities are integrated into the broader field marketing strategy.

What You'll Bring:

- Experience leading regional field marketing strategy and programs within a high-technology, B2B organisation; cybersecurity industry experience preferred.

- Experience working with partners or channel organisations to develop joint marketing plans and execute co-marketing activities that deliver measurable business outcomes.

- Native-level fluency in English. A Nordic language as an additional language would be an advantage but not mandatory.

- In-depth understanding of demand generation and marketing strategies across EMEA.

- Strong commercial mindset with experience managing marketing budgets and prioritising investment against business outcomes.

- Proven ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, hyper-growth environment and influence senior stakeholders across functions and organisations.

- Strong project management and collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and deliver integrated programs across Sales, Marketing, and external partners.

- Experience with key marketing and sales tools (Salesforce, Marketo knowledge a plus).

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Sales Engineering - US Public Sector
jobs.description:
With 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, Recorded Future is the world’s most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

Recorded Future is seeking a technically credible, hands-on leader for the Sales Engineering team supporting our US Public Sector business. This role is ideal for a builder with deep security expertise, proven PreSales leadership, and experience navigating complex government environments. You’ll join as Recorded Future strengthens its dedicated US Government organization, backed by Mastercard and an established position in threat intelligence. This is a rare opportunity to lead a talented team and help shape the evolution of our Public Sector business.

What You’ll Do as the Senior Manager, Sales Engineering - US Public Sector

- Lead, coach, and develop a distributed team of Sales Engineers supporting Federal, DoD and Intelligence Community, Civilian, State, and Local Government customers.

- Establish a consistent operating model across team coverage, technical sales processes, performance expectations, and leadership visibility.

- Assess team capabilities and capacity, addressing development, hiring, performance, and career-growth needs.

- Partner with Public Sector sales leaders to clarify Account Director and Sales Engineer accountability and create a more proactive working model.

- Standardize technical discovery, demonstrations, Proof of Value engagements, technical validation, and post-sale handoffs.

- Lead from the front on strategic opportunities and help the team secure the technical win.

- Partner with Product, Professional Services, Intelligence Services, and Channel to improve customer outcomes and inform Public Sector strategy.

What You’ll Bring as the Senior Manager, Sales Engineering - US Public Sector

- 4+ years leading a Sales Engineering, PreSales, or technical selling organization within cybersecurity.

- Meaningful experience supporting Public Sector customers, ideally including Federal, DoD, or Intelligence Community organizations.

- Deep technical knowledge of threat intelligence and security operations, including SIEM, SOAR, APIs, integrations, and related technologies.

- Experience building or improving Sales Engineering processes, coverage models, operating rhythms, and performance visibility.

- A track record of developing mixed-tenure teams, hiring strong talent, and addressing performance gaps.

- The ability to personally support sophisticated discovery, demonstrations, Proof of Value engagements, and technical customer conversations.

- A hands-on, highly accountable leadership style with strong cross-functional and executive communication skills.
